qualification: Uncalibrated analytical list schedule over captured source dependencies; not measured hardware performance, a cycle-accurate simulation, or an architecture optimum.

scheduler.policy: Captured-order deterministic earliest-start list scheduling. Each operation uses its modeled compute pool, shared-L1 service, and HBM service concurrently; each resource is exclusive for its modeled service duration. Dispatch is serialized. This is a coarse analytical contention abstraction, not a physical bank/interconnect simulator.

plateauDefinition.rule: First positive sampled value for which every available exact-doubling scheduled-latency improvement is below the threshold. A lower-bound flag means the true knee may be below the sampled range. Null means the sampled range did not establish a sustained knee.

errors: Estimated DSP demand exceeds the configured usable budget.
